title: Vue 3 Migration Execution Risks
risk_statement: Executing Vue 3 migration using parallel agent approach carries risks of breaking consuming applications, introducing bugs through AI-generated code, and coordination failures between parallel agents.

acceptance.reason: Migrating from Vue 2 to Vue 3 is necessary to eliminate critical security risks (RA-000002). While migration carries execution risks, staying on Vue 2 is riskier. Parallel agent approach is innovative but requires coordination. Mitigations in place reduce risk to acceptable level for 6-8 week migration period.

mitigations.detail: Require >80% test coverage for all migrated components before acceptance
Daily senior developer review and approval of all agent-generated code
Maintain Vue 2 version as fallback during entire migration
Alpha/beta testing with pqs-frontend before stable release
Comprehensive integration tests with both Vuex and Pinia adapters
Non-overlapping component assignments to prevent agent conflicts
Daily merges to prevent big-bang integration issues
Define migration patterns in .cursor/MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md for consistency
Git branches and version pinning allow immediate rollback if needed
Track build outputs, bundle size, and performance metrics throughout
